summary: Fortitude Gold Corp filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its company agreement with Hawthorne Land Minerals, LLC, regarding tax matters for East Camp Douglas, LLC. No financial terms, prices, or transactional structure are disclosed; the amendment solely revises how the LLC handles certain tax allocations. This is a routine operational update to an existing governance agreement, not a special situation event. No board recommendation or advisor is named. There is no deal to watch or arbitrage angle.
